scripts.docker:bootstrap: node scripts/generate-docker-env.mjs && docker compose --profile dev up --build -d
scripts.docker:bootstrap:dev:ai: node scripts/generate-docker-env.mjs && env ENABLE_OLLAMA=true docker compose --profile dev --profile ai up --build -d
scripts.docker:up:dev:ai: env ENABLE_OLLAMA=true docker compose --profile dev --profile ai up --build -d
scripts.docker:bootstrap:prod: node scripts/generate-docker-env.mjs && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --build -d
scripts.docker:up:prod:ai: env ENABLE_OLLAMA=true docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile ai up --build -d
scripts.docker:up:prod:backup: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --profile backup up -d postgres-backup
